notes.title: The game is being remade!!!
notes.content:
Our game is about to be one year old since EA!
During this year, we received a lot of feedback from players and discussed and collided with players.
After summarizing the collected information, we decided to make a new remake of the game.
This will be the final version officially released!
In the new version, we will launch a new interface, add an achievement system, increase the difficulty mode, redraw enemy pictures and card pictures, and redesign card values.
It will be a "new" game!
We will work hard to launch this version as soon as possible, please stay tuned! ! !

notes.content:
[b] Players are welcome to join the QQ group: 285414806, and discuss with us the genre of the game, the types of masks, values and gameplay, etc.[/b]
[b]Note: We forgot to enable search in the QQ group before, and the settings have been modified ːsteamsadː[/b]
This is a small update with the following changes:
According to player feedback, some Tarot events are too weak. This change:
1. Strengthen the event effect of the "Power" tarot card;
2. Strengthen the event effect of the "Moon" Tarot card;
3. The "Priestess" tarot card may give more layers of unknown abilities;
4. The number of ability fragments dropped by "the Wheel of Fortune" will be tripled.

[b]Preview of the next regularly update:[/b]
New mechanisms are currently being developed.
Ability chips can not only be used to synthesize new masks, but will also be able to enhance existing masks.
Stay tuned ~

notes.title: Update v0.1.3.0
Launching on 03.23!
notes.content:
Hello players, "Under the Mask" will be released on the Steam platform on 03.23, and the price is expected to be $4.99.

As a deck-building game, we'll be participating in next week's Steam Deckbuilders Fest.

Roll the dice and make your decision:

Start the battle and pursue the victory:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822271/3cd0c19970369a4f0b9b47942f77e13e7af18647.gif[/img]
